newsitem.title: UK: BCC urges 1p rise in standard UK income tax rate.
newsitem.headline: BCC urges 1p rise in standard UK income tax rate.

text.p: The British Chambers of Commerce said on Thursday that it would like to see a 1p rise in the standard rate of UK income tax in order to dampen consumer demand.
"We said when income tax was cut by the Chancellor in the budget that it was a penny too far. We'd like to see that reversed," said Ian Peters, BCC deputy director general.

Both major parties contesting the May 1 election have committed themselves to not increasing income tax. But the BCC said a tax rise would be by far the best policy "Politicians always have a choice and they will have to live with the consequences of their actions," Peters said.
Analysts expect the next government to cool the economy down with interest rate rises rather than tax increases.
